must_fix.title: Dialog backdrop has no styling hook, so backdrop-click close and the modal focus trap cannot work in a real (style-agnostic) page
must_fix.evidence: src/Dialog.tsx:284-299 renders the backdrop as a bare <div> with only event handlers; className and the other props go to the inner role=dialog panel. Probe rendering <Dialog open title="T"> printed `<div><div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" ...>`: the backdrop has no class, attribute or props. Unstyled, it is only as large as the panel, so clicks outside the panel hit page content (no onOpenChange(false)) and move focus out of the dialog. Tests pass only because jsdom fires clicks on the backdrop element directly. Needs a backdropClassName/overlay props or a data attribute, plus a test.

nits: Combobox filtering trims whitespace-only text but not other text: typing ' app' shows 'No results' instead of Apple.
Controlled Tabs whose value names a disabled tab selects nothing and shows no panel, while uncontrolled defaultValue on a disabled tab falls back to the first enabled tab; neither is documented.
ArrowDown on a closed Combobox activates the first enabled option rather than the currently selected one.
README intro says native props go to each component's root element, but Dialog forwards them to the panel and Combobox to the <input>.
An empty tests/ directory was created after the PR files (untracked by git, but included in tsconfig); possibly a leftover.
